artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dynamic pose with one arm raised, likely adjusting or holding their hair. The individual's face is in profile view, revealing soft facial features and long, flowing hair. They are draped in a long garment that billows outward, suggesting movement. The fabric appears soft and pliable, flowing around their form. The individual is barefoot and has no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is a plain, neutral-colored surface.

artworks.description: The image shows a person viewed from behind, standing with their left arm raised and bent at the elbow, and their right arm extended downward. The person is wearing a headwrap and a long, flowing garment with a fabric or sash around their lower body. The background is a plain, neutral beige color.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"

artworks.description: The image shows a person in motion, captured mid-step with arms raised and legs apart. The person's facial features are not detailed, and they are wearing a cap and a loose garment that creates a sense of movement. The background is plain and light in color.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image showcases abstract shapes outlining two figures standing back-to-back, both draped in flowing garments. The lines convey fabric movement like waves, captured mid-swish. The figures have smooth oval-shaped heads without facial features, enhancing the abstract quality. One figure's arm is outstretched at the elbow, resembling a gesture or holding pose, while the other figure's arm is raised over the head, evoking a sun-shielding gesture. The composition suggests elements of ancient sculptures or classical statues, depicting a timeless dance between figures in motion.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"

artworks.description: The image shows a figure sitting with full visibility of their body from head to toe. They are seated on the ground, leaning slightly to one side with their legs extended in front and their arms resting on their knee. The person's face is turned in profile without detailed features. Their hair is styled in a bun with two golden hairpins. They are wearing draped clothing that flows loosely around their body and is gathered around the knees. The background is a solid light beige color.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays an abstract shape with curved and angular lines. The silhouette resembles a seated human figure, with knees bent and arms resting. Muted tones and a textured surface add to its abstract quality. The figure's outline against a plain background emphasizes its form, suggesting a serene, contemplative posture.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image is of a person lying on their side with their arms supporting them. The person leans forward with one arm extended and the other arm bent. Their face is turned towards the viewer and they have dark, short curly hair. They wear a loose garment draped over one shoulder, revealing part of the chest. The clothing is a faded green or grey color. The background is a plain, light sandy color. There are no visible objects or intricate details in the background and the figure does not have any visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a bent posture and gesturing with their right hand. The facial features are not defined, and the head is tilted slightly to the side with hair covered by a hood. The person wears a long, flowing garment that covers their body and is gathered around the shoulders and waist. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is a plain, light beige.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a side profile position, with a focus on the upper half of their body. The person is depicted kneeling and slightly leaning forward, with arms extended. Their facial features are not clearly visible due to shading, and their hair is pulled back. The person's body is partially draped in a light fabric. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain light color.

artworks.title: Un rendez-vous
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts two individuals in a face-to-face position. On the left is a person wearing a tall black top hat and a suit with a defined facial features. The attire consists of a dark jacket with a visible white cuff. On the right, another individual is portrayed with a shaggy dark hair, prominent eyebrows, and a goatee. They are wearing a light-colored coat with intricate designs over a patterned vest and shirt. Both characters are not holding any objects, and the background is plain with vertical shading suggesting a wall or curtain behind them.

artworks.title: Artists' Evening
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Twin Oak Corporation)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple people gathered in a room. Most individuals are seated around tables, appearing close together. On the right, an older man with a beard and receding hairline is standing and talking to another man in a suit. The older man looks calm yet engaged, while the younger man's face is partly shadowed, making his features less clear. In the foreground, a young child with short dark hair and a thoughtful expression looks at the viewer. The child is dressed in a dark outfit with a white collar. On the left, other people are seated at a table, deeply focused on a possible discussion or activity. The background is dimly lit with a chandelier casting a soft glow. The walls feature framed pictures or portraits, enhancing the atmosphere of an enclosed, possibly elegantly simple space.

artworks.title: Ma greffe d'un cerisier sur un abricotier n'a pas pris ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person tending to a plant in a garden with a house in the background. The drawing shows a figure leaning over to examine or work on a small tree or plant surrounded by other foliage. In the background, there is a house, depicted simply with a few windows and a slanted roof. Text is visible around the lower section.

artworks.title: Un neveu qu gagne cruellement une succession
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people and a dog. The person on the left is seated on a chair with short, dark hair and wearing a long-sleeve garment. They hold a small dog in their lap, while another small dog rests on the back of the chair. The person on the right is seated and facing forward with their hair styled up, wearing a patterned garment and holding a hand fan close to their face. The room is furnished with drapes, a framed portrait on the wall, and a sculpture on a pedestal. The floor is covered with a patterned rug.

artworks.title: Un amour propre satisfait
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a man from the waist up. He is seated, leaning back with his left arm resting on a table. His right hand holds a large newspaper, which he appears to be reading. The man has a round face with small eyes, a prominent nose, and full lips. His hair is dark, curly, and neatly styled around his head. He is dressed in formal attire, wearing a dark jacket over a high-collared shirt and a thick white cravat. On the table in front of him, there is a tray with a carafe, a glass, and two plates with food. The background features an indistinct pattern of text, likely from the newspaper or wall.

artworks.title: The Last of the Buffalo
artworks.medium: photogravure in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Women's Committee of the Corcoran Gallery of Art)

artworks.title: General Washington
artworks.medium: hand-colored mezzotint and engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Josephine Boardman Crane)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, slightly turned to the side with one leg crossed over the other and leaning on a cane. The person's face is oval-shaped, with fair skin, light-colored eyes, and a prominent nose. Their hair is brown, parted in the middle, and styled in a typical 18th-century fashion. The individual is dressed in an 18th-century military uniform, consisting of a blue coat with gold epaulettes, a light-colored waistcoat, trousers, and black knee-high boots. They hold a black tricorne hat under one arm. To the right, a person of African descent is standing slightly behind, next to a dark-colored horse, holding the reins. The background features a cloudy sky and a landscape with what appears to be cliffs or hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Un usage d'Inde
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two individuals in a traditional setting engaged in a conversation. The scene shows one figure on the left wearing a robe and a hat leaning forward with an open mouth, appearing to speak intently. The other figure on the right has a different style of headgear, possibly a turban, and facial expressions suggesting surprise. The drawing's style is satirical and exaggerated, common in caricature art. The background resembles text, typical of editorial cartoons. The piece likely belongs to a satirical series, as indicated by the accompanying text.

artworks.title: Un banquet de barbistes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. Three individuals are seated at a table with plates and glassware, and one standing figure is raising a glass in a gesture that suggests a toast. The table is set with a champagne bottle and various dining utensils. The background includes newspaper text. This is a black-and-white illustration characterized by detailed shading. The drawing employs exaggerated facial features and expressions.

artworks.title: Une consultation scientifique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are shown from the waist up examining objects. The man on the left is slightly angled towards the right, while the man on the right is angled towards the left. The man on the left has curly hair and wears glasses, a dark jacket over a white shirt, and holds a round object. The man on the right has wavy hair and holds a magnifying glass, examining a similar object. The background is shaded, with the title "LES BEAUX JOURS DE LA VIE" written at the top. Text is visible below.

artworks.title: Dis donc ... mon mari ...j'ai bien envie d'appeler mon drama ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals in a room. The woman is on the left, standing in profile, facing the man to her right. She has an updo hairstyle and a prominent profile with a slightly open mouth. She is wearing a long, dark, voluminous dress with long sleeves. Her posture is upright, and her left hand is raised, pointing towards the man. The man, standing directly opposite her, appears to be holding a garment or cloth in both hands. His facial features include a wrinkled forehead and a pronounced chin, and his hair seems messy. He wears a jacket over a striped shirt and patterned pants. In the background, there is a framed artwork on the wall behind the woman. The room has a simple and subdued aesthetic. Text is printed above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Mr. Alfred Cabassol ... recevez ce signe de l'honneur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of children lined up, visible from the waist up, with their attention focused on an older man. The man is bent over slightly, facing the child in the foreground, and appears to be attaching something onto the child's garment. His features include glasses and aging lines, with thin, swept-back hair. The child he is attending to has short, neatly combed hair and is wearing a dark shirt with a white collar. The other children in the background have similar haircuts and clothing. The scene is set against a plain background fading into the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: Silhouette of Lieutenant Philip Kearney, Jr.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Virginia Livingston Hunt)
artworks.description: The image shows a silhouette of a person standing in profile facing left. The silhouette captures the full-body of the person, with one foot slightly forward and hands placed behind their back. Facial features are not visible, but the profile includes a prominent nose and sloped chin, with medium-length hair styled back. The person is wearing a long coat, trousers, and likely depicts a 19th-century style. The background is beige with a small base below the silhouette bearing cursive writing indicating a date and name. No visible jewelry or objects are held in the person's hands.

artworks.title: Ah! Ciel maman maman ... Ah! Dieu ma fille ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two individuals in a dramatic scene with animals in the background. One person is shown with wide-open eyes and arms raised, seemingly elevated by an animal. The other person appears to have fallen to the ground, with arms outstretched. In the background, another person is riding a donkey while observing the scene. The background includes trees or bushes. The caption in French reads "Ah! Ciel maman maman! ah! Dieu ma fille, ma fille!" which translates to "Oh! Heaven mom mom! oh! God my daughter, my daughter!" The drawing employs strong contrasts and dynamic lines, characteristic of a satirical or caricature style, emphasizing exaggerated expressions and poses to convey emotions and humor.

artworks.title: Ce qu'on appelle, aller jouir a la campagne ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are two people walking in heavy rain. On the left, a man in a long overcoat and top hat carries a bundled object resembling a swaddled baby. On the right, a woman in a long dress and shawl has her head down against the rain. The background shows a stormy landscape with puddles forming on the muddy ground from the rain.
